steps.text: jei-pinyin-search: open the inventory so JEI's ingredient overlay is up (the harness's throwaway level is creative, so the inventory bind opens the creative inventory)

jei-pinyin-search: focus JEI's search bar. Fabric presses its key directly: JEI's own key mappings read key.keyboard.unknown at runtime on this loader (measured 2026-10-14 in both KeyMapping.ALL and Options.keyMappings, while options.txt carries the defaults), so press_bind has nothing to press, and JEI's focus key needs no modifier here either (options.txt holds a plain key.keyboard.f, with none of NeoForge's ':CONTROL' encoding)
jei-pinyin-search: type the pinyin of 石头 (shi tou) one character at a time
